title: Anthropic 募资 904 亿剑指史上最大 IPO，认购已超六倍
content:
According to people familiar with the matter, the IPO of Anthropic, the developer of Claude, has attracted orders for about six times the shares available for subscription, as investor enthusiasm keeps rising for what could be the largest stock offering ever. The prospectus shows that the company and its co-founders plan to raise up to $64.4 billion through the IPO, plus a further $26 billion private placement, a two-pronged effort to stock up ammunition for its public-market debut. Amid debate over whether the AI investment boom is cooling, real-money subscriptions have cast the bluntest vote.
Add the two together, and it leapfrogs SpaceX to take the top spot Combining the IPO and private placement, the size could reach up to $90.4 billion, surpassing SpaceX's listing deal in one fell swoop and claiming the title of the largest listing in history. This sky-high offering is also seen as a milestone for AI companies entering the capital markets. However, the people cautioned that offering details, including demand, could still change; the information is not yet public, the sources requested anonymity, and Anthropic has not yet commented.
Existing backers get first dibs, new buyers may get squeezed The allocation is already skewed: bankers told potential investors that Anthropic will prioritize existing backers, and some new buyers may end up with fewer shares than expected. With the deal six times oversubscribed, it will not be easy for latecomers to get a slice; old friends have already taken most of the seats at the capital feast, leaving new faces to pick up leftovers.

report.summary: Anthropic 拟最高募资 904 亿美元，认购超六倍，或成史上最大 IPO
report.background: Anthropic 是 Claude 系列模型的开发商，由一批前 OpenAI 研究人员创立，背后有 Google、亚马逊等科技巨头重仓支持。过去两年，AI 一级市场估值飞涨，但进入 2025 年后,"AI 泡沫是否见顶"的争论不断，二级市场对高估值科技资产的承接能力也受到质疑。在此背景下，Anthropic 推进上市，采用"IPO + 大额私募"两条路径募资，被视为 AI 公司首次大规模登陆公开资本市场的标志性事件。若募资规模落实，将超越 SpaceX，成为史上最大上市交易。
key_points: 认购需求约为可认购份额的六倍，真金白银的订单成为对"AI 投资降温论"最直接的回应。
募资采用 IPO 加私募两条路径：IPO 最高 644 亿美元，另配 260 亿美元私募，合计最高 904 亿美元，一举超越 SpaceX。
份额分配明显偏向老股东：承销商已告知潜在投资者将优先现有投资方，新买家可能拿到的股份少于预期。
消息尚未官方确认：细节（含最终需求）仍可能变化，信源匿名，Anthropic 未作回应，需以正式招股文件为准。
若成行，这将标志着 AI 公司正式进入公开资本市场的定价体系，为后续同类公司上市提供参照锚点。
report.impact: 对 AI 行业，这是一次资本信心投票，也为其他大模型公司的估值和上市路径设定基准；对开发者，Claude 生态的资金与算力投入会更充足，但上市后对营收、毛利和商业化落地的压力会显著上升，API 定价与开放策略可能趋于收紧；对普通用户，产品迭代和功能扩张有望加速，但订阅价格调整、企业级功能优先级提升、数据使用政策变化都值得关注。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注 Claude 及 Claude Code、Anthropic API、MCP（Model Context Protocol）协议与 Agent SDK；信息跟踪建议直接查阅 SEC EDGAR 上的 S-1 招股书原文，以及 Anthropic 官方博客与开发者文档。
